description.value: Corcelettes Estate Winery is a 160-acre small-lot estate winery in the Similkameen Valley, consistently ranked in the Top 10 Small Wineries at the National Wine Awards of Canada. Visitors can experience curated wine flights seated on a scenic patio, shop estate wines in the on-site wine shop, or stay overnight at the Sunshot Vineyard Guest House. The winery's portfolio — Bordeaux varietals, Syrah, Pinot Noir, and Chardonnay — is grown entirely in the valley's distinctive stony, mineral-rich soils.
